notes: A standalone, strictly monochrome editorial website about the tones between black and white, with a pointer-reactive Canvas field, a luminance-matching instrument, six procedurally drawn plates, a selectable grey register, inverted theme, print styles and reduced-motion support. No runtime model identifier was exposed, so unknown-model is used as required. No external assets, fonts, libraries or network calls; all imagery is SVG or Canvas. Known limitation: the interactive instruments require JavaScript, although the editorial text and initial captions remain in the HTML. Model identity confirmed by the operator as Hy4.
